notes.title: Morph! will be updated soon!
notes.content:
Morph! will be updated soon to reflect various feedback!

1. The number of global game matching players has increased from 2 to 4.
2. All skills are unlocked when you create an account.
3. UI usability has been improved.
4. Minor bugs have been fixed.

Morph! is an indie game developed by one person. Bug reports and feedback are always welcome.
Email: vldkdhtudrjs@gmail.com

The update will roll out simultaneously to iOS and Android, including Steam.

notes.title: Morph! has been released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sl79ZlQvZOY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Morph! is now available on Steam, AppStore, and GooglePlay[/h1]

[h2]Morph!, developed by one person, supports public and private matches. [/h2]
- Two players can enjoy the game together through public matches. The number of players is being monitored and will be increased to 4 in the future.
- You can enjoy it with your friends through private matches!

[h2]Although we have done a lot of testing, there may be bugs in the game[/h2]
The game will become more stable through bug reports from players, and so that a variety of players can enjoy it, please send bug-related information to the email address below and we will review and fix it.
vldkdhtudrjs@gmail.com


[h2]I want to produce and service fun games[/h2]
Any ideas, balance, or improvements related to the game are always welcome! Please send your information to the email address below and we will actively accept it and update it.
vldkdhtudrjs@gmail.com
